displayName: LGD Change Gate（医械 AI 变更判定）
description: Decide whether a change to a medical-device AI or ML function needs formal change control, and return a pass, hold or reject verdict with auditable reasons. Medical-device AI/ML change-control judgment per the LGD three laws (有籍 Recorded / 有证 Evidenced / 有门禁 Gated). Trigger when the user asks whether a device-software or algorithm change requires change control, asks for a risk verdict (pass/hold/reject), asks for change-level classification (minor/major/critical), or asks for an LGD-theory judgment with auditable reasons. Applies to regulated environments (FDA 510(k)/PMA, EU MDR, ISO 13485) and other AI/ML medical-device change evaluations.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
